_comment: Golden Path template for multi-episode narrative dispatches. The engine reads this file when --dispatch-template is passed, substitutes {{episode_number}}, {{episode_title}}, {{protagonist}}, {{antagonist}}, {{setting}}, {{diegetic_clock}}, and {{operator_choice}} from the previous episode's decision_history.json (when running episode >= 2), then dispatches the resulting master objective as if the user had typed it on the command line.
name: episode_pattern

substitutions.episode_number: 1-based episode number (read from the dispatch flag or auto-incremented from state/decision_history.json)
substitutions.episode_title: Free-text title, e.g. 'The Letter That Wasn't Sealed'
substitutions.protagonist: Full name, e.g. 'Eira Vance, colonial archivist'
substitutions.antagonist: Full name, e.g. 'Director Hale, Internal Surveillance'
substitutions.setting: Setting name + region + era, e.g. 'Solstice Bay, Northern Reach, year 3147'
substitutions.diegetic_clock: Time anchor, e.g. '11 days after the seal was opened' or '48 hours before the convoy arrives'
substitutions.operator_choice: The most recent Gate 2 (CRITICAL) decision from state/decision_history.json, formatted as 'the operator chose: <deepen peril | hold the line | off-screen resolution>'. Empty string on episode 1.

deliverables.name: script
deliverables.description: Full episode script. Must reference the diegetic clock in scene 1 and resolve (or escalate) the prior episode's dangling thread.

deliverables.name: character_bible_delta
deliverables.description: New or changed character attributes for this episode. Carry forward unchanged characters from prior episodes verbatim.

deliverables.name: ambient_soundscape
deliverables.description: 60-90 second ambient loop. Must include one signature sound (the {{setting}} equivalent of 'the lighthouse foghorn' or 'the colony's dawn bell').

deliverables.name: portrait_set
deliverables.description: At least one new portrait per new character introduced this episode. {{protagonist}} reuses prior portrait if unchanged.

deliverables.name: map_delta
deliverables.description: SVG showing the new location. If {{setting}} is unchanged from prior episode, this can be a 'no-change' marker.

deliverables.name: lore_document
deliverables.description: In-world lore supporting this episode. Cross-link to the script and the map.

deliverables.name: continuity_audit_log
deliverables.description: Per-rule pass/fail with citations back to the script. Written by the Continuity Engine.

hitl_gates.ask: Approve the script for media generation? (approve and continue pre-approves the rest of the routine gates)
Moral hinge: should the {{antagonist}} learn about {{protagonist}}'s correspondence? (Deepen the peril / Hold the line / Off-screen resolution)
Approve the final pack for delivery to $VORTEX_HOME/deliverables/{{project}}/? (Approving writes .manifest.json and freezes the deliverables)

self_heal_targets: Tone drift (script suddenly formal where prior episodes were terse)
Anachronism (prop or phrase that doesn't fit the {{setting}} era)
Character contradiction ({{protagonist}} acts against an established trait from a prior episode)
Lore duplication (same fact stated twice with conflicting detail)
Map inconsistency (location described in script not present in map delta)
